title: smelting touchs
description: This mod adds a new enchantment called Smelting Touch. It can be added to an item, and when you hold shift and break the block, it gets cooked automaticly when you have this enchantment on your tools
body: **_important_** "This has to be on an item, and you have to shift for it to work." This mod adds a new enchantment called smelting touch. It works like a furnace on Pickaxe. It smelts the ore when you mine it
